description: Defines classes and methods for HR management, including timesheet groups, employee categories, employees, and timesheets, with database interactions and business logic.

classes.name: hr_timesheet_group
classes.description: Manages groups of timesheets and related scheduling logic.

classes.name: hr_employee_category
classes.description: Represents hierarchical employee categories with recursion checks.

classes.name: hr_employee
classes.description: Represents employee data with hierarchy constraints.

classes.name: hr_timesheet
classes.description: Represents individual timesheet entries with scheduling details.

methods.name: interval_min_get
methods.description: Calculates minimum interval times based on hours and timesheet data.

methods.name: interval_get
methods.description: Calculates time intervals based on hours and timesheet data.

methods.name: _check_recursion
methods.description: Checks for recursive parent-child relationships in categories and employees.
